content.text: Cameroonian digital creators face significant barriers when trying to sell products online, especially with conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe unavailable. Fortunately, with blockchain-based payments and Cloudflare's robust infrastructure, you can deploy a system that allows you to sell digital products effortlessly and securely. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment gateways often fail creators in Cameroon due to restrictions and high fees. By leveraging blockchain technology, you gain instant transactions and low fees. For example, USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10. This efficiency allows you to transact seamlessly while retaining full control over your earnings and customer data, eliminating the dependency on unreliable platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital commerce stack, ensure you have a few essential tools. You will need a Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for managing documents and files, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. These tools enable you to create a system that processes payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing flexibility for international customers. Prepare your product files, and familiarize yourself with GitHub or Cloudflare Pages for deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your digital commerce stack through the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack. With these stacks, you'll integrate NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing. Set up your Cloudflare Pages to host your storefront and use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. This configuration ensures that once payment is confirmed, your digital products are delivered automatically, providing instant gratification for your customers.
Blockchain payments eliminate currency barriers and high transaction fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your store and test the payment processing system with a small transaction. Ensure everything works as intended, from payment verification through NOWPayments to product delivery via your chosen file storage solution. After confirming that your first transaction processes successfully, you can confidently promote your digital products to both local and international buyers without the barriers imposed by traditional payment gateways.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
You maintain full ownership of your data and digital products after deployment.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept payments in Cameroon without PayPal?

You can accept payments in Cameroon through NOWPayments, which allows you to process cryptocurrency transactions directly. This way, you sidestep traditional payment processors that may not support your region.
What are the transaction fees with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a competitive 0.5% fee on transactions. This is significantly lower than many traditional payment gateways, making it an attractive option for digital creators.
How long does it take to receive payments?
Payments processed through NOWPayments settle in under 60 seconds, allowing you to receive funds quickly. This rapid processing is crucial for maintaining cash flow in your digital business.
Can I sell to international buyers from Cameroon?
Yes, by using a blockchain-based payment system like NOWPayments, you can easily sell digital products to international buyers without the limitations of conventional payment processors.
What types of products can I sell using this infrastructure?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, software, and more. The infrastructure allows for seamless delivery and payment processing for any digital creation.
Deploying a sovereign commerce stack empowers you to scale without restrictions.
